in_arabic.name: زَيدَنَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: زَيدَنَةُ: اسمُ مُصَنَّفٍ يُشيرُ إلى الزَيدانِ، المُعتَرَفينَ بالإِسْلَامِ، والمُتَمَسِّكينَ بِأَمَلِ الرِزْقِ. ويُستَخْدَمُ في الإِسْمِ مِنَ الأَزْوَاجِ وَالأَبناءِ. يُشيرُ إلى الرِجالِ المُتَمَسِّكينَ بِالعَدَلِ، وَالذينَ يَرغَبونَ في الأَمانِ. يُعتَبَرُ الزَيدانُ كَأَنَّهُمُ أَنَفَةُ الدُنْيَا، وأَولى بِالرِزْقِ. ويُشيرُ الإِسمُ إلى الأَولى في الأَمرِ، والذينَ يَحْمِلونَ الأَمورَ وَالحُكْمَ.

in_urdu.meaning: زیدانہ نام کی وجہ تسمیہ، عَظیم خَواتین کی تعداد میں سے ہیں۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: زیدانہ نام، اسلام میں مُعترف ہونے والے اور رزق کے امیدواروں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام، خواتین اور بچوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلام میں، ایسے مردوں کو زیدان کہا جاتا ہے جو انصاف اور امین ہونے کی وجہ سے مشہور ہیں۔

in_english.name: Zaydanah
in_english.meaning: Zaydanah is an Arabic name derived from 'zayd' meaning 'growth' or 'increase', often used for women and children, referring to those who are steadfast in their faith and hope for guidance.
in_english.long_meaning: Zaydanah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'zayd', which means 'growth' or 'increase'. In Islamic tradition, it is used to refer to women and children who are steadfast in their faith and hope for guidance. The name is also associated with those who are known for their integrity and righteousness. In Arabic, the root 'zayd' is also connected to the concept of 'zayd', which refers to the first fruits or the best of something. Therefore, the name Zaydanah can be interpreted as 'the first fruits of faith' or 'the best of guidance'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaydanah is derived from the Arabic language, rendering the meaning 'The Beautiful One, The One with Grace and Charm'. This name carries great significance in Islamic cultures, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah is beautiful and loves beauty." (Bukhari). The emphasis on beauty and charm in this name can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic belief in the aesthetic aspect of life and the inherent beauty and value of creation. Zaydanah would likely evoke admiration and respect in her community for her grace, charm and beauty, further reinforcing the importance placed on these qualities in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zaydanah also holds deep spiritual meaning, as the Islamic belief ascribes beauty to Allah and his creation. In Islamic traditions, the name of Allah, Ar-Rahman (The Most Gracious) is repeated frequently as a reminder of Allah's compassion, mercy and grace towards His creation. By namesake, Zaydanah embodies the spiritual qualities of grace and beauty from the Divine Creator. Additionally, the name's origin from the Arabic language, recognized as the language of the Quran, connects Zaydanah spiritually to the Islamic faith and tradition. The name serves as a constant reminder of the beauty and grace present in Allah's creation, and in turn, inspires Zaydanah to lead a virtuous, beautiful life in accordance with Islamic teachings.
